decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s core pipeline and valve business for the same customer groups, it is likely to meet or come close to aspiration levels and is worth retaining.
Although distant from the core offer, the waste bin can use existing metalworking and coating resources and may be tolerated while management tests municipal demand under available slack.
This broader waste-bin-with-ashtray line has some overlap with public-sector customers and enough scope to justify continued trial unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

Standalone outdoor ashtrays are the weakest strategic fit and, if their sales remain below aspiration, behavioral-theory logic points to reallocating resources back to the core infrastructure business or other developments.
